content.short: imToken is one of Asia's most trusted self-custodial crypto wallets, supporting Mantle and 20+ blockchains with built-in DeFi and NFT tools.
content.description: imToken is a leading self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet that has been trusted by over 14 million users in more than 200 countries since 2016. The wallet supports Mantle Network and over 20 other blockchains, providing a comprehensive mobile-first experience for managing crypto assets, interacting with DeFi protocols, and collecting NFTs. imToken also offers an integrated hardware wallet (imKey) for institutional-grade security. Its strong reputation in Asia makes it a key wallet for Mantle's growing user base in that region.
